newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds steady in light trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds steady in light trade.

text.p: Prices on the UK meals and feeds market were steady on Wednesday in light trading.
High protein soymeal ex-mill Liverpool was unchanged for most positions with only Jun/Oct showing any changed at two stg up.
On the east coast stores were around one stg higher for high pro and Brazilian 48's.
Rapemeal sellers were unchanged ex-mill and on the resale market along with sunflower pellets and meal.
Corn gluten feed pellets in Liverpool were three stg up to unchanged while Portbury was two stg higher to unchanged.
Sunflowermeal 40 percent protein ex-store Liverpool traded at 125 stg for spot.
Some brokers said they had heard reports of spot corn gluten trading but details could not immediately be obtained.
